topic: Surunkali obstruktiv o'pkaning patomorfologik xususiyatlari Kasalliklar

slides.title: Kirish: KOAH patomorfologiyasi va ma‘ruza rejasi

bullets.text: KOAH (surunkali obstruktiv o‘pka kasalligi) — havo oqimini asta-sekin yomonlashtiradigan o‘pka kasalliklarining umumiy “soyabon” atamasi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Emfizema KOAHning eng keng tarqalgan tarkibiy qismlaridan biri: unda o‘pka elastikligi yo‘qoladi va gaz almashinuvi buziladi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Ikkinchi bo‘lim kichik havo yo‘llariga bag‘ishlanadi: diametri 2 mm dan kichik, tog‘aysiz bronxiolalar KOAHning eng erta bosqichlarida ko‘p zararlanadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Maqsad: emfizema va kichik havo yo‘llari o‘zgarishlarini tushunish hamda “erta aniqlash, erta tashxis, erta aralashuv” tamoyilini o‘zlashtirish.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega KOAHni “soyabon” atama deb atashadi? 2) Nima uchun kichik havo yo‘llari “jim zona” deyiladi? Doskada chizish: KOAH markazda, ikki shox — emfizema va kichik havo yo‘llari kasalligi. Tipik xato: KOAH va emfizemani bir xil tushuncha deb hisoblash; emfizema KOAHning tarkibiy qismi xolos.

slides.title: KOAH va emfizema: ta‘rif, morfologiya, belgilar

bullets.text: Emfizema — terminal bronxiolalardan distal havo bo‘shliqlarining asta-sekin kengayishi bo‘lib, bu bo‘shliqlar devorlarining buzilishidan kelib chiqadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Havo xaltachalari vaqt o‘tib yorilib, bitta “katta xalta” hosil qiladi va havo tutilib qoladi; kislorod qonga qiyin o‘tadi, o‘pka esa “to‘lib” boradi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Belgilar: nafas qisishi, balg‘amli surunkali yo‘tal, xirillash, ko‘krakda siqilish. Dastlab ular yengil bo‘lib, e’tibordan chetda qolishi mumkin.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Kasallik dunyo aholisining taxminan 9–10 foizida uchraydi va yaqin yillarda o‘lim sabablari orasida uchinchi o‘rinni egallashi kutilmoqda.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Havo xaltachalari yorilsa, nega kislorod qonga qiyin o‘tadi? 2) Nima uchun dastlabki belgilar e’tiborsiz qoladi? Doskada chizish: normal alveolalar va birlashib katta xaltaga aylangan alveolalar sxemasi. Tipik xato: emfizemani faqat “o‘pkaning havo bilan to‘lishi” deb bilish; asosiy mohiyat — devorlarning buzilishi.

slides.title: Emfizemaning xavf omillari

bullets.text: Asosiy xavf omili — sigaret chekish. Atrof-muhit omillari ham muhim: havo ifloslanishi, chang va kimyoviy moddalar.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Havo ifloslanishida zarrachalar tarkibidagi ikkilamchi organik aerozollar (SOA) emfizema rivojlanishining muhim xavf omili sifatida ko‘rsatilgan.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Genetik omil — alfa-1 antitripsin (neytrofil elastazaning asosiy fiziologik ingibitori) tanqisligi; u ayniqsa chekuvchilarda xavfni oshiradi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Takroriy nafas yo‘li infeksiyalari (masalan, pnevmoniya) va astma ham emfizema xavfini oshiradi yoki uning rivojlanishini tezlashtiradi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Alfa-1 antitripsin tanqisligi chekuvchida nega xavfni ayniqsa oshiradi? 2) Qaysi xavf omillarini oldini olish mumkin? Doskada chizish: xavf omillari ikki guruhga — o‘zgartirib bo‘ladigan (chekish, havo) va genetik (alfa-1 antitripsin). Tipik xato: infeksiyani emfizemaning asosiy sababi deb hisoblash; u faqat xavfni oshiruvchi omil.

slides.title: Patogenez gipotezalari: umumiy ko‘rinish

bullets.text: Emfizema patogenezi murakkab va to‘liq tushunilmagan; asosan alveolalar, bilvosita kichik nafas yo‘llari zararlanadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Proteaza–antiproteaza muvozanatsizligi genetik va chekishdan kelgan emfizemada eng markaziy gipoteza hisoblanadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Diqqat: elastik tola shikasti va to‘qima tortilishining yo‘qolishi oqibat; ularni birlamchi sabab deb bo‘lmaydi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega bitta gipoteza emfizemani to‘liq tushuntirmaydi? 2) Mexanizmlar bir-birini istisno qiladimi (manbaga ko‘ra yo‘q, ular o‘zaro ta’sirlashishi mumkin)? Doskada: yetti mexanizmni markazda proteaza–antiproteaza bo‘lgan aylana sxemada chizdiring, oqibat mexanizmlarini alohida belgilang. Tipik xato: elastik tola shikastini birlamchi sabab deb hisoblash. Manbada tartib sub’ektiv ekani ham aytilgan.

slides.title: Proteaza–antiproteaza muvozanatsizligi

bullets.text: Uzoq ta’sir proteazaga boy muhit yaratadi; proteazalar asosan elastinni parchalaydi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Neytrofil elastaza (NE) inhibitori alfa-1 antitripsin (A1AT) tanqisligi emfizemaga moyil qiladi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Tajriba: proteaza geni o‘chirilsa sichqon himoyalanadi; o‘pkaga proteaza yuborilsa emfizema chiqadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega A1AT tanqisligida emfizema chekmaydigan odamda ham rivojlanishi mumkin? 2) Tajriba dalillari gipotezani qanday quvvatlaydi? Doskada: tarozi chizing, bir pallada proteazalar (NE), ikkinchisida inhibitor (A1AT), elastin esa o‘rtada. Tipik xato: emfizemani faqat infeksiya natijasi deb o‘ylash; manbada u yallig‘lanish va nazoratsiz proteazalar bilan bog‘langan.

slides.title: Oksidant–antioksidant muvozanatsizligi

bullets.text: Oksidantlar (vodorod peroksid, azot oksidi va b.) oqsil, lipid va nuklein kislotalarni shikastlaydi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Oksidantlar proteaza inhibitorlarini inaktivlaydi; yangi chaqirilgan hujayralar siklni kuchaytiradi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Nrf2 (eritroid-2 bog‘liq omil) katalaza va glutation sintezini boshqaradi; buzilsa emfizema og‘irlashadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega oksidantlar proteaza–antiproteaza muvozanatiga ham ta’sir qiladi? 2) Nrf2 buzilishi nimaga olib keladi? Doskada: 3-tugundan 2-tugunga qaytuvchi strelka bilan o‘z-o‘zini kuchaytiruvchi sikl chizing. Tipik xato: oksidantlarni faqat tashqi manba (tutun) deb hisoblash; endogen manba ham faol hujayralardir (neytrofil, makrofag, epiteliy).

slides.title: Yallig‘lanishning o‘zini ushlovchi halqasi

bullets.text: Chekish kabi qo‘zg‘atuvchilar sitokin, oksidant va proteazalarni ajratib, alveola devorini shikastlaydi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Elastin bo‘laklari — elastokinlar — xemotaktik va yallig‘lanishni kuchaytiruvchi xususiyatga ega.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Elastokinlarni neytrallash yoki retseptoriga bog‘lanishini to‘sish nazariy davo nishoni sifatida ko‘riladi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: nega elastokinlar halqani yopuvchi bo‘g‘in hisoblanadi? Elastokinlar ham marker, ham davo nishoni bo‘la oladimi? Doskada: 5 tugunli halqani strelkalar bilan chizib, oxirgi tugundan birinchisiga qaytuvchi strelka qo‘shing. Tipik xato: elastokinlarni elastinning o‘zi deb o‘ylash; ular proteaza ta’sirida hosil bo‘lgan bo‘laklar.

slides.title: Doimiy immun javob va apoptoz

bullets.text: Bronxoalveolyar lavaj suyuqligi va to‘qima tahlilida kasallik og‘irligidan qat’i nazar makrofaglar ustunlik qiladi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Bu makrofaglarda fagotsitoz biroz buzilgan, ular to‘qimani shikastlovchi molekulalar ajratadi. CD8+ limfotsitlar ham patogenezga hissa qo‘shadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Hujayraviy yallig‘lanish javobi chekishni tashlagandan keyin ham davom etadigandek ko‘rinadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Emfizemali o‘pka to‘qimasida alveolyar to‘siqlardagi apoptotik epitelial va endotelial hujayralar ko‘paygan; tajriba hayvonlarida ham shu topilgan.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: chekishni tashlash nega yallig‘lanishni darhol to‘xtatmasligi mumkin? Apoptoz qanday hujayralar yo‘qolishiga olib keladi? Doskada: makrofag va CD8+ limfotsitdan alveolyar to‘siqqa strelkalar chizing. Tipik xato: apoptozni kasallikni boshlovchi omil deb hisoblash; manbada u boshlovchi emas, progressiya va qaytmaslikka hissa qo‘shuvchi omil deyilgan.

slides.title: Elastik tola shikasti va mexanik kuchlar buzilishi

bullets.text: Elastik tolalar (elastin, fibrillin) alveola to‘siqlari butunligini saqlaydi va nafas chiqarishda mexanik qaytishni ta’minlaydi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Proteazalar (neytrofil elastaza, MMP-12, katepsinlar) elastinni parchalaydi; oksidantlar alfa-1 antitripsinni (A1AT) inaktivlaydi va elastinni oksidlaydi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Elastik tola shikasti birlamchi sabab emas, oqibatdir; biroq kasallik boshlanishi va avj olishida zararli rol o‘ynaydi. Natijada havo bo‘shliqlari kengayadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Cho‘zilish va qaytish buzilsa, notekis shikast stress zonalarini va qolgan alveolalarning kompensator haddan ortiq kengayishini beradi; zarar davom etadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: elastik tolalar yo‘qolsa nafas chiqarish nega qiyinlashadi? Notekis shikastlanishdan so‘ng qolgan alveolalar nima uchun ortiqcha zo‘riqadi? Doskada: sog‘lom alveola bilan emfizemali alveolani yonma-yon chizib, tortib turuvchi tolalarni ko‘rsating. Tipik xato: elastik tola shikasti emfizemaning birlamchi sababi deb o‘ylash; manbada u oqibat, lekin zararli rol o‘ynashi aytilgan.

slides.title: Mexanizmlarning nisbiy ahamiyati tartibi

bullets.text: Eng markaziy — proteaza–antiproteaza muvozanati buzilishi; genetik va chekishdan kelgan emfizemada.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Oksidlovchi stress proteazani kuchaytiradi, apoptozni oshiradi; yallig‘lanish proteaza va oksidant manbai.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Diqqat: apoptoz va tamirlash buzilishi — sabab emas, oqibat; ularni boshlovchi deb adashmang.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

items.title: 1. Proteaza–antiproteaza
items.text: Eng markaziy; genetik va chekishdan emfizemada

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun proteaza–antiproteaza gipotezasi markaziy deb olinadi? 2) Sabab va oqibat farqi nimada? Doskada: 5 ta mexanizmni ahamiyat zanjiri ko‘rinishida chizing, sabablarni bir rangda, oqibatlarni boshqa rangda belgilang. Tipik xato: apoptozni boshlovchi omil deb o‘ylash. Eslatma: mualliflar bu tartib ‘‘ma’lum darajada subyektiv’’ va gipotezalar bir-birini inkor etmasligini aytadi.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: chekuvchi va alfa-1 antitripsin

bullets.text: Vaziyat: 45 yoshdan kichik chekuvchi bemorda nafas qisilishi va balg‘amli surunkali yo‘tal; emfizema aniqlandi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Alfa-1 antitripsin neytrofil elastazaning asosiy inhibitori; tanqislikda xavf ortadi, ayniqsa chekuvchilarda.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Chekish oksidantlarni ko‘paytiradi; oksidantlar proteaza inhibitorlarini inaktivlab, to‘qima buzilishini kuchaytiradi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Savol: bu bemorda qaysi mexanizmlar birgalikda ishlaydi va nega alfa-1 antitripsin tanqisligini tekshirish kerak?

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Kutilgan javob: genetik tanqislik (elastaza nazoratsiz) + chekish (oksidant, inhibitorni inaktivlash) → elastin parchalanishi, alveola devori buzilishi. Manbaga ko‘ra alfa-1 antitripsin tanqisligini skrining qilish barcha emfizemali bemorlarga, ayniqsa 45 yoshdan kichik yoki chekmaydiganlarga tavsiya etiladi. Muhokama: 1) Chekish bu holatda xavfni qanday oshiradi? 2) Nega ikki mexanizm bir-birini kuchaytiradi? Doskada: ‘‘tanqislik + chekish → proteoliz’’ sxemasini chizing. Tipik xato: genetik va chekishdan kelgan emfizemani butunlay alohida jarayon deb bilish. Vaziyat o‘quv maqsadida soddalashtirilgan.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: emfizema patogenezi

bullets.text: 1-savol: patogenezning qaysi gipotezasi genetik va chekishdan kelgan emfizemada eng markaziy hisoblanadi?

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: 2-savol: elastik tola shikasti emfizemaning boshlang‘ich sababimi yoki oqibatmi? Yakuniy natijasi nima?

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: 3-savol: elastin tolalari qaysi ikki yo‘l bilan buziladi? Misollar keltiring.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: 4-savol: chekishni to‘xtatgandan keyin ham qaysi limfotsitlar bilan bog‘liq yallig‘lanish davom etadi?

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq (blits, har savolga ~1 daq). Javoblar: 1) proteaza–antiproteaza nomutanosibligi; 2) oqibat, lekin boshlanish va avj olishda zararli rol o‘ynaydi; yakuniy natija — havo bo‘shliqlarining kengayishi; 3) proteazalar (neytrofil elastaza, MMP-12, katepsinlar) elastinni parchalaydi; oksidantlar A1AT kabi inhibitorlarni inaktivlaydi va/yoki elastinni bevosita oksidlaydi; 4) CD8+ T-limfotsitlar. Muhokama: nega elastik tola shikasti ‘‘oqibat’’ bo‘lsa-da, muhim? Doskada: elastin buzilishining ikki yo‘lini chizing. Tipik xato: elastik tola shikasti va proteaza gipotezasini bir xil deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Kichik havo yo‘llari: ta‘rif va ‘jim zona‘

bullets.text: Kichik havo yo‘llari — ichki diametri 2 mm dan kichik, xaftaga tayanchsiz bronxiolalar; COPD ning eng erta bosqichida ko‘p zararlanadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Ular membranoz va respirator bronxiolalar hamda alveolyar yo‘llardan iborat; taxminan 8–15-avlod shoxlanishdan boshlanib, terminal bronxiolalar bilan tugaydi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Yo‘li tor va xaftaga tayanchi yo‘q, shuning uchun zararli zarrachalarga o‘ta sezgir. Ammo klinik jihatdan ko‘rinmaydi, shu bois ularni ‘jim zona‘ deb atashadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Kichik yo‘llar funksiyasi buzilishi ko‘pincha alomat, spirometriya yoki rentgen o‘zgarishidan oldin boshlanadi; terminal bronxiolalar avval yo‘qolishi mumkin.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun kichik yo‘llar ‘jim zona‘ deyiladi? 2) Spirometriya normal bo‘lsa ham kichik yo‘l kasalligi bo‘lishi mumkinmi? Doskada: bronxial daraxtni chizib, 2 mm chegarasi va 8–15-avlodni belgilang. Tipik xato: kichik yo‘llarni alveolalar bilan adashtirish; bu bronxiolalar, alveolalar esa ularning distalida joylashgan.

slides.title: Kichik va katta havo yo‘llari: solishtirish

bullets.text: Kichik yo‘llar devori yupqa; ichi kiprikli ustunsimon, distalda kubsimon epiteliy bilan qoplangan.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Normada umumiy qarshilikning taxminan 10% ini beradi; COPD erta bosqichida qarshilik sezilarli oshadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Nafas chiqarish oxirida tortuvchi kuch kamayib, kichik yo‘llar kollapsga moyil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

columns.title: Kichik yo‘llar
items: Gaz zichligi ta’siri kam yoki yo‘q
Sirt faol qatlam kollapsni oldini oladi

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Laminar oqim nega gaz zichligiga kam bog‘liq? 2) Sirt faol qatlam kollapsdan qanday himoya qiladi? Doskada: ikki ustunli jadvalni talabalar bilan birga to‘ldiring. Tipik xato: kichik yo‘llarning qarshilikka hissasi normada katta deb o‘ylash; aslida taxminan 10%, lekin kasallikda keskin oshadi. Diqqat: laminar ≠ turbulent oqim.

slides.title: Kichik yo‘l kasalligi: uch bosqichli yo‘l

bullets.text: Boshlanish: tamaki tutuni va ifloslik epiteliyni shikastlab, shilliq tiqin hosil qiladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Kengayish: neytrofillar, so‘ng makrofag va T-limfotsitlar kirib, mediatorlar va hujayra qarishi kuchayadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Qayta qurilish: silliq mushak giperplaziyasi, fibroz va kapillyarlar kamayishi yo‘llarni toraytiradi.

source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

items.title: Boshlanish
items.text: Tutun epiteliyni shikastlaydi, shilliq tiqin hosil bo‘ladi

items.text: Silliq mushak giperplaziyasi, fibroz, kapillyar kamayishi

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun neytrofillar eng birinchi hujayralar hisoblanadi? 2) Qaysi bosqichda o‘zgarishlar qaytmas bo‘lib qoladi? Doskada: boshlanish → kengayish → qayta qurilish zanjirini strelkalar bilan chizing va har bosqichga bitta asosiy hodisa yozing. Tipik xato: bosqichlar tartibini aralashtirish; masalan fibrozni boshlanish bosqichiga qo‘yish.

slides.title: Boshlanish: epitelial shikast va EMT

bullets.text: Tutun va havo ifloslanishi kichik yo‘l epiteliysini qayta-qayta shikastlaydi, shikast va tiklanish tsikli takrorlanadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: TGF-β, Wnt/β-katenin va Notch yo‘llari epiteliy-mezenximal o‘tishni (EMT) boshlaydi; hujayra mezenxima xususiyatini oladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: STAT3 fibrozni kuchaytiradi; PINK1-Parkin buzilsa reaktiv kislorod turlari (ROS) ortadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega takroriy shikast tiklanish tsikli kasallikni boshlaydi? 2) EMT qanday o‘zgarishlar bilan namoyon bo‘ladi? Doskada: shikastdan shilimshiq tiqingacha bo‘lgan zanjirni chizdiring. Tipik xato: EMT tomonidan yo‘l obstruksiyasiga qo‘shgan hissasini aniq isbotlangan deb hisoblash; manbada bu munozarali deyilgan.

slides.title: Shilimshiq tiqin va to‘siq buzilishi

bullets.text: Tutun va ifloslik kosasimon hujayralar ko‘payishiga hamda MUC5AC va MUC5B shilimshiq oqsillari ortishiga olib keladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Zich birikma oqsillari buziladi, shilimshiq-kirpikchali tozalanish va to‘siq yaxlitligi yomonlashadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Sekretor IgA (SIgA) va polimer immunoglobulin retseptori (pIgR) kamayadi; antimikrob to‘siq zaiflashib, infeksiyaga moyillik ortadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Shilimshiq to‘planishi havo oqimini to‘sadi va mikroblar ko‘payishiga qulay muhit yaratadi; tiqin kasallik og‘irligi bilan bog‘liq.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Shilimshiq tiqin nega yallig‘lanishni kuchaytiradi? 2) SIgA kamayishi infeksiyaga moyillikka qanday olib keladi? Doskada: tiqin, yallig‘lanish va infeksiya o‘rtasidagi yopiq doirani chizdiring. Tipik xato: shilimshiq tiqinni faqat mexanik to‘siq deb o‘ylash; manbada u mikroblar uchun muhit ham yaratadi.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: kichik yo‘llarda shilimshiq tiqin

bullets.text: Vaziyat: chekuvchida spirometriya me’yorda. Manbaga ko‘ra, patologik o‘zgarishli bemorlarda ham FEV1 va FVC saqlanib qolishi mumkin.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Tahlil: kichik yo‘llar epiteliy shikasti, tiqin va yallig‘lanish bilan kasallikni erta boshlashi mumkin, ammo spirometriya buni sezmasligi mumkin.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: spirometriya me’yorda bo‘lsa, kichik yo‘l shikastini qaysi usullar erta aniqlashi mumkin?

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: me’yoriy spirometriya ≠ sog‘lom kichik yo‘llar. Tiqin tez-tezligi kasallik og‘irligi bilan bog‘liq.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Spirometriya me’yorda bo‘lsa-yu, bemorda kichik yo‘l shikasti bo‘lishi mumkinmi? 2) Erta aniqlash uchun qanday qo‘shimcha usullar kerak (masalan, impuls ossillometriya, ko‘p nafasli yuvish, HRCT-PRM)? Doskada: «me’yoriy spirometriya» va «kichik yo‘l shikasti» ni ikki ustunda solishtiring. Tipik xato: me’yoriy spirometriyani kasallik yo‘qligi deb talqin qilish.

slides.title: Kengayish: immun hujayralar va mediatorlar

bullets.text: Sigaret tutuni va zarralar epiteliy hamda alveolyar makrofaglarni faollashtiradi; ular TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6 va CXCL8, LTB4 (xemokinlar) chiqaradi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: KOO da kichik yo‘llarga birinchi bo‘lib neytrofillar kiradi; keyin makrofaglar va CD4+/CD8+ T-limfotsitlar keladi, ular to‘qimani sitotoksik shikastlaydi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Tutun va zarralar NF-κB hamda p38 MAPK yo‘llarini faollashtirib, sitokinlar ajralishini davom ettiradi; oksidlovchi stress PI3K/Akt/mTOR ni ham ishga soladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: KOO bemorlarining taxminan 20–40 foizida eozinofilli fenotip bor; u kichik yo‘l disfunksiyasi bilan bog‘liq va IKS ga yaxshi javob berishi mumkin.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun kichik yo‘llarda avval neytrofillar, keyin makrofag va T-limfotsitlar paydo bo‘ladi? 2) Eozinofilli fenotipni aniqlash davolashni qanday o‘zgartiradi? Doskada: hujayralar ketma-ketligini strelkalar bilan chizing (neytrofil → makrofag → T-limfotsit) va har biriga mediatorni yozing. Tipik xato: yallig‘lanishda faqat neytrofillar bor deb o‘ylash; manbada keyingi bosqichda makrofag va T-limfotsitlar ham qatnashadi.

slides.title: Hujayra qarishi va SASP

bullets.text: Yallig‘lanish va oksidlovchi stress hujayralarni ATM/ATR–p53/p21 yo‘li orqali qarish holatiga o‘tkazadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Qarigan hujayralar SASP (sekretor fenotip) ajratadi: IL-6, IL-8, MMP-9, MMP-12. Qo‘shnilar ham qariydi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: miR-34a ortib, SIRT1/6 (antioksidant va tiklovchi fermentlar) ni susaytiradi; SASP turg‘un bo‘lib qoladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) SASP nima uchun yallig‘lanishni kuchaytiradi? 2) miR-34a va SIRT1/6 o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlik nimani anglatadi? Doskada: yopiq halqa chizing (yallig‘lanish → qarish → SASP → yangi qarish). Tipik xato: qarishni oddiy hujayra o‘limi bilan adashtirish; qarigan hujayra o‘lmaydi, doimiy o‘sishdan to‘xtaydi va omillar ajratadi.

slides.title: NLRP3 inflammasoma va substans P

bullets.text: NLRP3 inflammasoma yallig‘lanish kuchaytirgichi: ROS, hujayradan tashqari ATF va lizosoma beqarorligi uni faollashtiradi; IL-1β va IL-18 yetiladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: IL-1β neytrofillarni jalb qilib, ROS–IL-1β kuchaytirish halqasini hosil qiladi. Tajribada NLRP3 ni to‘sish bu halqani uzdi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Substans P tutun ta’siriga neyrogen yallig‘lanish beradi: shilliq ajralishi va infiltratsiya kuchayadi. Ortiqcha ifodasi fibrozga olib kelishi mumkin.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: NK1 retseptor antagonistlari (masalan, aprepitant) hayvon modelida yallig‘lanish va fibrozni kamaytirdi. Mexanizm va klinik dalillar dastlabki bosqichda.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) ROS–IL-1β halqasini qaysi nuqtada uzish mumkin? 2) Substans P nima uchun ham tiklovchi, ham fibrozga olib keluvchi ta’sir ko‘rsatadi? Doskada: ROS → NLRP3 → IL-1β → neytrofil → ROS halqasini chizing. Tipik xato: NK1 antagonistlari KOO da isbotlangan davo deb o‘ylash; manbada ular hayvon modellarida sinalgan va dalillar dastlabki.

slides.title: Qayta qurilish: silliq mushak va fibroz

bullets.text: Silliq mushak hujayralari ko‘payib va kattalashib, devorni qalinlashtiradi va kichik yo‘llarni toraytiradi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Fibroblastlar α-SMA musbat miofibroblastga aylanib, I/III tur kollagen va laminin ko‘p ishlab chiqaradi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: MMP/TIMP muvozanati buzilib, matriks parchalanishi ham, kollagen cho‘kishi ham bir vaqtda kechadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Qisqartmalar: ASM (havo yo‘li silliq mushagi), TGF-β (o‘zgartiruvchi o‘sish omili-β), PDGF (trombotsitlardan olingan o‘sish omili), EMT (epiteliy-mezenximal o‘tish), MMP (matriks metalloproteinaza), TIMP (MMP to‘qima ingibitori), α-SMA (α-silliq mushak aktini). Muhokama: nima uchun MMP/TIMP buzilishi bir vaqtda ham yemirilish, ham cho‘kish beradi? Doskada: diagrammadagi 5 bosqichni strelkalar bilan chizdiring va har bosqichga bitta signal yo‘lini yozdiring. Tipik xato: fibrozni faqat yemirilish deb o‘ylash; manbada ikkalasi birga kechishi (fazoviy notekis qayta qurilish) ta’kidlanadi.

slides.title: Tomir o‘zgarishlari: arterial va kapillyar

bullets.text: Arterial remodeling va kapillyar siyraklashuvi ikki alohida angiopatiya bo‘lib, ta’siri har xil.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Tomografiyada distal arteriyalar hajmining kamayishi (arterial pruning) emfizema tezlashuvini bashorat qiladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Ular sinergik: arterial gipertenziya kapillyar yo‘qotishni, kapillyar yo‘qolishi qarshilikni oshiradi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Diqqat: arterial remodeling ≠ kapillyar siyraklashuvi. Birinchisi qarshilikni (gemodinamika), ikkinchisi gaz almashinuvini buzadi. Qisqartmalar: DLCO (o‘pkaning diffuziya sig‘imi), V/Q (ventilyatsiya/perfuziya nisbati), pruning (distal arteriyalarning kamayishi). Muhokama: qaysi o‘zgarish o‘ng qorincha yuklamasini oshiradi va nima uchun? Doskada: ikki ustunli taqqoslash jadvalini daftarga chizdiring. Tipik xato: ikkalasini bitta jarayon deb aytish.

slides.title: Bir hujayrali omika ma‘lumotlari

bullets.text: Terminal bronxiolalar atlasida KOBL ning erta bosqichida (GOLD I–II) M1-simon makrofag va neytrofillar alveola birikkan joylarda to‘planadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Bu hujayralar elastik tolalar parchalanishi bilan bog‘liq: immun infiltratsiya va matriks shikastlanishi vaqt va joy jihatidan bir-biriga yaqin.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Bazal hujayra, fibroblast va immun hujayralar ligand–retseptor tarmog‘i yallig‘lanish va matriks omillarini boshqarib, qaytmas remodellanishni kuchaytiradi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: T-hujayra va makrofaglarda RNK metilatsiyasi va autofagiya genlari faol, yallig‘lanish bilan bog‘liq; bu epigenetik signal yuqori bo‘g‘in bo‘lishi mumkin.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. GOLD (Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease) bosqichlari: I–II erta bosqich. Muhokama: nima uchun hujayralar aynan alveola birikish joylarida to‘planishi muhim? Epigenetik signal sababmi yoki oqibatmi? Doskada: terminal bronxiola, alveola va ularga yig‘ilgan hujayralar sxemasini chizing. Tipik xato: 4-bandni isbotlangan sabab deb aytish; manbada bu faqat taxmin (suggesting) sifatida berilgan.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: arterial pruning

bullets.text: Vaziyat: COPDGene kogortasida KT da distal mayda arteriyalar hajmining kamayishi (arterial pruning) o‘rganilgan; u emfizema avj olishi bilan bog‘liq.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Boshlang‘ich parenxima shikastini hisobga olmaganda ham, dastlabki arterial pruning emfizema tezlashuvi va o‘pka funksiyasi pasayishini oldindan ko‘rsatgan.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Aniq KOO belgisiz chekuvchilarda erta arterial pruning o‘pka tomirlari qarshiligini oshirib, o‘ng qorincha remodellanishiga hissa qo‘shishi mumkin.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Savol: nega arterial pruning faqat hamroh o‘zgarish emas, balki kasallik rivojining mustaqil omili sifatida talqin qilinadi?

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: (1) Parenximal shikastlanishni hisobga olgandan keyin ham bashorat kuchining saqlanishi nimani anglatadi? (2) Chekuvchida simptomlar yo‘q bo‘lsa ham KT nega foydali? Doskada chizish: normal va kesilgan (pruning) distal arteriyalar daraxti, o‘ng qorincha tomon strelka. Tipik xato: pruning ni kapillyar rarefikatsiya bilan aralashtirish; pruning KT da ko‘rinadigan distal arteriyalar hajmining kamayishi.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: kichik yo‘llar va qayta qurilish

bullets.text: 1-savol: EMT (epiteliy-mezenximal o‘tish) paytida epiteliy hujayralari nimani yo‘qotadi va qanday fenotip egallaydi?

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: 2-savol: SASP (senessensiya bilan bog‘liq sekretor fenotip) nima va unga qaysi omillar kiradi?

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: 3-savol: qayta qurilish (remodeling) bosqichida qaysi uchta jarayon vaqt va makon bo‘yicha bir-biriga bog‘liq?

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Diqqat: arterial remodeling ≠ kapillyar rarefikatsiya. Birinchisi tomir qarshiligini oshiradi, ikkinchisi diffuziya sig‘imini (DLCO) kamaytiradi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Javoblar: (1) qutblilik va hujayralararo aloqalarni yo‘qotadi, mezenxima-o‘xshash fenotip oladi (ko‘chish va kollagen to‘planishi kuchayadi); (2) senessent hujayralar ajratadigan yallig‘lanish va fibrozga undovchi omillar: IL-6, IL-8, MMP-9, MMP-12; (3) silliq mushak proliferatsiyasi, ECM fibrozi va tomirlar pruningi. Muhokama: EMT va SASP qanday qilib bir-birini kuchaytiradi? Doskada: Initiation → Expansion → Remodeling zanjiri. Tipik xato: remodeling ni faqat fibroz deb tushunish, tomir o‘zgarishlarini unutish.

slides.title: Erta aniqlash: spirometriya

bullets.text: MMEF (FEF25–75%) — FVC ning 25–75% qismidagi o‘rtacha forsirlangan oqim; periferik yo‘llarni aks ettiradi, erta SAD da kamayadi, FEV1 dan sezgirroq.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: MMEF sezgirligi va o‘ziga xosligi yetarli emas. Erta SAD da FEV1 va FVC saqlanishi mumkin, shu sabab spirometriya sezgirligi cheklangan.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Muqobil ko‘rsatkich FEV3/FEV6: FEV3 kichik yo‘llar havosini ham ko‘proq qamraydi, FEV6 esa FVC ni aniq o‘lchash zaruratini yo‘qotadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: FEV3/FEV6 me‘yorning pastki chegarasidan past bo‘lsa, FEV1/FVC normal chekuvchilarda ham KT da gaz tutilishi va fSAD aniqlanishi mumkin.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

columns.title: MMEF (FEF25–75%)
items: Sezgirlik va o‘ziga xoslik yetarli emas

columns.title: FEV3/FEV6
items: FEV3 kichik yo‘llar havosini ko‘proq qamraydi
FEV6 FVC ni aniq o‘lchashni talab qilmaydi

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: (1) Nega FEV1 normal bo‘lib, kichik yo‘llar shikastlangan bo‘lishi mumkin? (2) Chekuvchini skrining qilishda FEV3/FEV6 ni qanday rolda ishlatish mumkin? Doskada: FVC egri chizig‘ini chizib, 25–75% oralig‘ini va FEV1, FEV3, FEV6 nuqtalarini belgilang. Tipik xato: MMEF ni mustaqil ishonchli ‘oltin standart’ deb qabul qilish; manbada u tortishuvli. Slaydda faqat ’qayta tuzilgan’ ma‘lumot: FEV3/FEV6 ning mortalitetga ta‘siri noaniq.

slides.title: Washout testlari va impuls-ossillometriya

bullets.text: Bir nafasli washout (SBW) sodda, lekin maksimal nafas kerak; sezgirligi cheklangan.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Ko‘p nafasli washout (MBW) tinch nafasda bajariladi; LCI ventilyatsiya notekisligini ko‘rsatadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Impuls-ossillometriya (IOS) tinch nafasga tebranish qo‘shadi; R5–R20 va X5 kichik yo‘llarni baholaydi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega MBW bolalar va chaqaloqlar uchun qulay? 2) IOS spirometriyadan qaysi jihati bilan afzal? Doskada chizing: SBW, MBW va IOS uchun ‘bemor kuchi’ o‘qi bo‘yicha taqqoslash chizig‘i. Tipik xato: LCI ni SBW parametri deb o‘ylash; LCI MBW ko‘rsatkichi, SIII esa SBW ko‘rsatkichi.

slides.title: Dinamik compliance chastotaga bog‘liqligi

bullets.text: Dinamik compliance (Cdyn) o‘pka elastikligi va yo‘llar qarshiligini birgalikda aks ettiradi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Sog‘lom o‘pkada vaqt konstantasi bir xil, shuning uchun nafas tezlashsa ham Cdyn deyarli o‘zgarmaydi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

Doskada chizing: τ = R⋅C formulasi va tez nafasda ikki xil hudud sxemasi. Tipik xato: Cdyn ni statik compliance bilan aralashtirish; statik compliance yo‘llar qarshiligiga bog‘liq emas, Cdyn esa bog‘liq.

slides.title: HRCT va parametrik javob xaritalash (PRM)

bullets.text: HRCT eng samarali usul, lekin ajratish qobiliyati ~2 mm — terminal bronxiolalar ko‘rinmaydi.

bullets.text: PRM juft skanerlar yordamida funksional kichik yo‘llar kasalligi (fSAD) va emfizemani ajratadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Cheklov: ikki skaner, ko‘p nurlanish va xarajat; bronx devori va shilimshiq tiqin uchun HRCT kerak.

Doskada chizing: PRM ning 5 bosqichli zanjiri va fSAD hamda emfizema hududlarini ajratuvchi sxema. Tipik xato: PRM ni struktura tasviri deb o‘ylash; u gaz tutilishi, ya’ni funksiyani ko‘rsatadi, devor qalinlashuvini esa HRCT baholaydi.

slides.title: SPECT va 19F MRT (VDP)

bullets.text: Bir fotonli emission tomografiya (SPECT) AUC-CV orqali ventilyatsiya notekisligini baholaydi, yengil o‘zgarishni ham sezadi.

bullets.text: 19F magnit-rezonans tomografiyada (MRT) VDP mahalliy havo tutilishini, FEV1 (1-soniya hajmi) esa umumiy cheklovni ko‘rsatadi.

bullets.text: Ikkala usul ham asosan tadqiqot vositasi bo‘lib, COPD ning kundalik diagnostikasiga hali kiritilmagan.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) VDP nima uchun FEV1 dan farq qiladi? 2) Nega bu usullar hali rutin emas? Doskada: VDP = ventilyatsiyalangan hajm / proton MRT hajmi sxemasini chizdiring. Qo‘shimcha: bronxodilatatordan keyin VDP astmada o‘rtacha 33%, COPD da 14% kamaygan. Tipik xato: SPECT/CT ni COPD skrining usuli deb o‘ylash; yo‘riqnomalar uni asosan o‘pka emboliyasi uchun tavsiya qiladi.

slides.title: Diagnostik usullarni solishtirish

bullets.text: Spirometriya oddiy va arzon, ammo erta kichik yo‘l kasalligida (SAD) sezgirligi yetarli emas.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Ko‘p nafas bilan yuvish (MBW) va impuls ossillometriya (IOS) spirometriya normal bo‘lganda ham sezgirroq.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Parametrik javob xaritasi (PRM) fSAD ni emfizemadan ajratadi, lekin ikki skan talab qiladi va qimmat.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Spirometriya normal bo‘lsa, kichik yo‘l kasalligini qaysi usul bilan izlaysiz? 2) PRM nima uchun rutin emas? Doskada: usullarni sezgirlik va qulaylik bo‘yicha ikki o‘qli sxemada joylashtiring. Tipik xato: normal FEV1 kichik yo‘l zararini istisno qiladi deb o‘ylash. Diqqat: fSAD ≠ emfizema, PRM ularni ajratadi.

Doskada: elastin parchalanishi → desmozin ajralishi zanjirini chizing. Tipik xato: hayvon modelini odam kasalligining to‘liq nusxasi deb hisoblash. Diqqat: sRAGE qonda, desmozin esa BAL, balg‘am, plazma va siydikda o‘lchanadi.

slides.title: Bronxodilatatorlar: β-2 agonistlar va antixolinergiklar

bullets.text: Bronxodilatatorlar havo yo‘llari mushaklarini bo‘shashtirib, havo oqimi pasayishi va nafas qiyinligini kamaytiradi: β-2 agonistlar va antixolinergiklar.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: β-2 agonistlar β-2 adrenoretseptorlarni qo‘zg‘atadi: adenilatsiklaza → cAMP → proteinkinaza A; silliq mushak bo‘shashadi, havo yo‘llari kengayadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Qisqa ta’sirli (salbutamol) — tez yengillik uchun; uzoq ta’sirli LABA (salmeterol, formoterol) — davomli davo; indakaterol kuniga bir marta.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Antixolinergiklar M3 muskarin retseptorlarini to‘sadi; ipratropiy bromid — qisqa ta’sirli, uzoq ta’sirli LAMA — davoning asosiy tayanchi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega LABA va LAMA birgalikda qo‘llanadi? 2) Bronxodilatatorlar emfizemani davolaydimi? Doskaga chizing: ikki dori turining retseptor mexanizmi. Tipik xato: bronxodilatatorni emfizemani davolovchi vosita deb o‘ylash (ular faqat simptomni yengillashtiradi).

slides.title: Kortikosteroidlar, antibiotiklar va PDE4 ingibitorlari

bullets.text: Kortikosteroidlar glyukokortikoid retseptoriga bog‘lanib, NF-κB va AP-1 ni susaytiradi; asosan tez-tez xurujlanuvchi bemorlarga, ko‘pincha inhalatsiya bilan.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Kortikosteroid xavfi: infeksiya, vazn oshishi, gipertoniya, osteoporoz; ba’zan kortikosteroid rezistentligi bo‘ladi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Antibiotiklar emfizemani davolamaydi (kasallik infeksiyadan emas), lekin bakterial xurujda tiklanish tezroq; makrolidlar in vitro yallig‘lanishga qarshi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: PDE4 ingibitorlari (roflumilast, rolipram, silomilast): ko‘ngil aynishi, diareya, bosh og‘rig‘i, uyqusizlik; ensifentrin — PDE3/PDE4 ingibitori.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Antibiotik emfizemada qachon foydali? 2) Kortikosteroid kimlarga ajratiladi? Doskaga chizing: uch ustunli jadval. Tipik xato: antibiotikni emfizemaning asosiy davosi deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Davolash va boshqarish: emfizema yondashuvlari

bullets.text: GOLD (Global Initiative for COPD) yo‘riqnomasida chekishni tashlash — kasallik rivojini sekinlatuvchi birinchi qator chora.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Uzoq ta’sirli antixolinergiklar va β-2 agonistlar (LAMA/LABA) kortikosteroid bilan yoki ularsiz simptomni kamaytiradi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Og‘ir emfizemada o‘pka hajmini kamaytirish; terminal bosqichda o‘pka transplantatsiyasi ko‘riladi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. COPD — surunkali obstruktiv o‘pka kasalligi; GOLD — shu kasallik bo‘yicha global yo‘riqnoma. Muhokama: 1) Nega chekishni tashlash birinchi o‘rinda? 2) Kortikosteroid qaysi bemorlarga qo‘shiladi (tez-tez avj olish)? Doskada: zanjirni 5 pog‘onali narvon shaklida chizdiring. Tipik xato: bronxodilatatorlar emfizemani davolaydi deb o‘ylash — ular faqat simptomni yengillatadi, o‘pka shikasti qaytmaydi.

slides.title: Yangi yo‘nalishlar: antifibrotik va senolitik

bullets.text: Inhalatsion glyukokortikoidlar (ICS) yallig‘lanish genlarini bosadi; qonda eozinofillar ko‘p bo‘lsa, ta’siri yaxshiroq bo‘ladi.

source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Pirfenidon transformatsiyalovchi o‘sish omili-β (TGF-β) yo‘lini, nintedanib (tirozinkinaza ingibitori) esa fibroblast ko‘payishini susaytiradi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Dasatinib + kversetin qarigan hujayralarni yo‘qotib, o‘pka fibrozi sichqon modelida fibroz omillarini kamaytirgan; odamda dalillar hali kam.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Kelajak: senolitiklar, mikroRNK yoki ekzosomaga asoslangan aralashuvlar, anti-TGF-β va antioksidant terapiya, neytrofil hamda PI3Kδ yo‘lini nishonga olish.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Senolitik dori nima uchun faqat qarigan hujayralarga ta’sir qilishi kerak? 2) Nega antifibrotik dorilar bo‘yicha dalillar hozircha asosan tajriba modellaridan? Doskada: «yallig‘lanish → qarish → fibroz» uchburchagini chizib, har tomonga bitta dori guruhini yozdiring. Tipik xato: sichqon modelidagi natijani odamda isbotlangan deb qabul qilish.

slides.title: Xulosa: asosiy xabarlar

bullets.text: Uch o‘zaro bog‘liq mexanizm: surunkali yallig‘lanish, fibroz va epiteliy-mezenximal o‘tish (EMT), hujayra qarishi va uning sekretor fenotipi (SASP).

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Emfizema COPD ning asosiy tarkibiy qismi bo‘lib, alveola devorlarining yemirilishi va o‘pka elastikligi yo‘qolishi bilan tavsiflanadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

bullets.text: Kichik nafas yo‘llari kasalligi (SAD) alveolar yemirilishdan oldin boshlanishi mumkin, shu sabab COPD ning dastlabki bosqichida muhim.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

bullets.text: Tamoyil: erta aniqlash, erta tashxis, erta davo; spirometriya normal bo‘lsa, MBW (ko‘p nafasli yuvish) va IOS (impuls ossillometriya) sezgirroq.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Muhokama: 1) Emfizema va SAD bir kasallikning ikki yuzi ekanini qanday tushuntirasiz? 2) Spirometriya normal bo‘lganda qaysi usullar yordam beradi? Doskada: SAD → emfizema → aniq COPD yo‘nalishini strelkalar bilan chizdiring. Qo‘shimcha: yuqori aniqlikdagi KT (HRCT) va parametrik xaritalash (PRM) funksional SAD ni emfizemadan ajratadi. Tipik xato: normal spirometriyani «kasallik yo‘q» deb talqin qilish.

mcq.question: Emfizema ta’rifiga ko‘ra, u qanday morfologik o‘zgarish bilan xarakterlanadi?
options: Proksimal bronxlar devorining qalinlashuvi
Alveolalar oralig‘ida biriktiruvchi to‘qima o‘sishi
Bronxlar silliq mushaklarining doimiy spazmi
Terminal bronxiolalardan distal havo yo‘llarining kengayishi
mcq.explanation: Emfizema terminal bronxiolalardan distalda joylashgan havo bo‘shliqlarining devorlari buzilishi natijasida asta-sekin kengayishi deb ta’riflanadi. Alveolalar yorilib, havo tutilib qoladigan katta bo‘shliq hosil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

mcq.question: Tajribada Nrf2 omili ifodasi buzilgan sichqonlarda og‘ir emfizema rivojlandi. Bu natija qaysi patogenetik mexanizmni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi?
options: Oksidant–antioksidant muvozanatsizligi
Proteaza–antiproteaza muvozanatsizligi
Hujayralar apoptozining kamayishi
Elastik tolalarning mexanik cho‘zilishi
mcq.explanation: Nrf2 antioksidant fermentlar sintezini boshqaradi. Uning ifodasi buzilsa, oksidantlar alveola devori va boshqa o‘pka to‘qimalarini zararlaydi va og‘ir emfizema rivojlanadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

mcq.question: Bemor chekishni tashlaganiga ancha vaqt bo‘ldi, ammo o‘pkasida CD8+ limfotsitlar bilan bog‘liq hujayraviy yallig‘lanish davom etmoqda. Bu qaysi mexanizmga mos keladi?
options: Faqat oksidantlarning tashqi manbadan kirishi
Alveolalar tortilishining mexanik yo‘qolishi
Alfa-1 antitripsinning tug‘ma yetishmovchiligi
Doimiy immun javob
mcq.explanation: Emfizemali o‘pkada makrofaglar ustun turadi, CD8+ limfotsitlar ham patogenezda ishtirok etadi. Bu hujayraviy yallig‘lanish javobi chekishni to‘xtatgandan keyin ham davom etadi, shuning uchun u doimiy immun javob deyiladi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

mcq.question: Elastin proteaza ta’sirida bo‘laklarga bo‘linib, hosil bo‘lgan peptidlar o‘pkaga yangi yallig‘lanish hujayralarini chaqirmoqda. Bu qaysi hodisaga misol bo‘ladi?
options: Apoptoz jarayonining kuchayishi
Yallig‘lanishning o‘zini ushlovchi halqasi
Alveolalar mexanik tortilishining yo‘qolishi
Antioksidant fermentlar sintezining ortishi
mcq.explanation: Elastinning proteaza ta’sirida parchalanishidan elastin peptidlari (elastokinlar) hosil bo‘ladi. Ular xemotaksis va yallig‘lanishni kuchaytirish xususiyatiga ega bo‘lib, ko‘proq yallig‘lanish hujayralarini chaqiradi va halqani davom ettiradi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

mcq.question: Emfizemada o‘pka to‘qimasi bir tekis zararlanmaganda, qolgan alveolalar kompensator ortiqcha kengayadi. Bu holat qaysi mexanizmning bir qismi hisoblanadi?
options: Antioksidant himoyaning kuchayishi
Proteaza inhibitorlari miqdorining oshishi
Mexanik kuchlar buzilishi va stress zonalari hosil bo‘lishi
Apoptozga qarshi mediatorlar faolligi
mcq.explanation: Notekis to‘qima shikasti ‘stress konsentratsiyasi zonalari’ va qolgan alveolalarning kompensator ortiqcha kengayishini keltirib chiqaradi. Bu qo‘shimcha mexanik zo‘riqish shikast va havo bo‘shliqlari kengayishi halqasini davom ettiradi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

mcq.question: Emfizema patogenezidagi mexanizmlar ichida qaysi biri genetik va chekishdan kelib chiqqan emfizema uchun eng markaziy gipoteza hisoblanadi?
options: Oksidant–antioksidant muvozanatining buzilishi
Alveolyar septa hujayralarining apoptozi
Proteaza–antiproteaza muvozanatining buzilishi
Mexanik kuchlar taqsimotining buzilishi
mcq.explanation: Mualliflar proteaza va ularning ingibitorlari muvozanatining buzilishini eng markaziy gipoteza deb baholaydi. Oksidativ stress chekuvchilarda ikkinchi o‘rinda turadi: u proteaza faolligini kuchaytiradi va apoptozni oshiradi. Apoptoz kasallikni boshlovchi omil emas, uning rivojlanishi va qaytmasligiga hissa qo‘shadi. Mexanik kuchlar buzilishi esa birlamchi sabab emas, ko‘proq oqibatdir.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

mcq.question: Alfa-1 antitripsin tanqisligi bo‘lgan chekuvchida o‘pka elastini tez parchalanmoqda. Buning asosiy sababi nima?
options: Neytrofil elastazani to‘sadigan asosiy ingibitor yetishmaydi
Makrofaglarning fagotsitoz faolligi to‘liq yo‘qolib ketadi
Havo yo‘llari silliq mushaklari haddan ziyod bo‘shashadi
Alveolalarda surfaktant ishlab chiqarilishi keskin oshadi
mcq.explanation: Alfa-1 antitripsin neytrofil elastazaning asosiy fiziologik ingibitoridir. Uning tanqisligi, ayniqsa chekuvchilarda, elastinni parchalovchi proteazalarni nazoratsiz qoldiradi. Natijada o‘pka tuzilmasi buziladi va emfizema xavfi ortadi.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

mcq.question: Chekuvchida spirometriya normal, lekin kichik havo yo‘llarida funksional buzilish bor. Bu yo‘llar nega "jim zona" deb ataladi?
options: Ularda silliq mushak va epiteliy butunlay bo‘lmaydi
Ularda havo oqimi doimo turbulent xarakterda bo‘ladi
Ular faqat tug‘ma kasalliklar paytida zararlanadi
Ularning erta zararlanishi simptom va spirometriyada sezilmaydi
mcq.explanation: Diametri 2 mm dan kichik va tog‘aysiz kichik yo‘llar ingichka bo‘lgani uchun zararli zarrachalarga juda sezgir. Shunga qaramay ular klinik jihatdan "ko‘rinmas" bo‘lib, erta funksional buzilish ko‘pincha simptomlar, o‘pka funksiyasi va rentgen o‘zgarishlaridan oldin kechadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

mcq.question: Kichik havo yo‘llarida gaz oqimi katta yo‘llardagi oqimdan qanday farq qiladi?
options: Asosan turbulent, gaz zichligiga juda bog‘liq bo‘ladi
Asosan laminar, gaz zichligi ta’siri minimal bo‘ladi
Asosan turbulent, gaz zichligi ta’siri minimal bo‘ladi
Asosan laminar, gaz zichligiga juda bog‘liq bo‘ladi
mcq.explanation: Katta yo‘llarda oqim asosan turbulent bo‘lib, gaz zichligi qarshilikka sezilarli ta’sir qiladi. Kichik yo‘llarda oqim asosan laminar, Reynolds koeffitsienti past, shuning uchun gaz zichligi o‘zgarishi qarshilikka deyarli ta’sir qilmaydi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

mcq.question: Chekuvchining kichik yo‘llarida qadahsimon (goblet) hujayralar ko‘paygan, MUC5AC va MUC5B ifodasi oshgan, sekretor immunoglobulin A kamaygan. Qanday oqibat kutiladi?
options: Mukotsiliar tozalanish yaxshilanib, infeksiya xavfi kamayadi
Epiteliy to‘sig‘i mustahkamlanib, yallig‘lanish o‘z-o‘zidan so‘nadi
Shilimshiq tiqin hosil bo‘lib, infeksiyaga moyillik ortadi
Havo yo‘llari kengayib, oqim qarshiligi sezilarli pasayadi
mcq.explanation: Goblet hujayralar proliferatsiyasi, mukotsiliar disfunksiya va mutsin ifodasining oshishi tozalanishni yomonlashtiradi. Sekretor immunoglobulin A va polimer immunoglobulin retseptori kamayishi epiteliyning antimikrob to‘sig‘ini zaiflashtiradi. Natijada shilimshiq tiqin hosil bo‘ladi, havo oqimi to‘silib, patogenlar ko‘payishi uchun qulay muhit paydo bo‘ladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.

mcq.question: Chekuvchi bemorning kichik havo yo‘llarida tutun ta’siriga javoban birinchi bo‘lib qaysi hujayralar infiltratsiya qiladi?
options: CD8+ T-limfotsitlar
Neytrofil granulotsitlar
Alveolyar makrofaglar
Eozinofil granulotsitlar
mcq.explanation: COPD (surunkali obstruktiv o‘pka kasalligi) da kichik yo‘llarga tutunga javoban birinchi bo‘lib neytrofillar kiradi. Keyin makrofaglar va CD4+/CD8+ T-limfotsitlar jalb qilinadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

mcq.question: Tadqiqotchi qarigan fibroblastlar atrofidagi qo‘shni hujayralarda ham qarish belgilarini topdi. Bu qaysi mexanizm bilan tushuntiriladi?
options: Goblet hujayralar sonining keskin kamayishi
ATM/ATR yo‘lining to‘liq susayishi
Faqat qarigan hujayraning o‘z ichki ta’siri
SASP omillarining qo‘shni hujayralarga ta’siri
mcq.explanation: Qarigan hujayralar SASP (qarish bilan bog‘liq sekretor fenotip) omillarini chiqaradi: IL-6, IL-8, MMP-9, MMP-12. Bu omillar parakrin yo‘l bilan qo‘shni hujayralarda ikkilamchi qarishni chaqiradi va yallig‘lanishni kuchaytiradi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

mcq.question: Bemorda ROS, hujayradan tashqari ATF va lizosoma beqarorligi ta’sirida IL-1β va IL-18 yetilishi kuchaygan, xurujlar qaytalanmoqda. Qaysi tuzilma bu halqaning asosiy kuchaytirgichi?
options: NLRP3 inflammasoma
PINK1–Parkin yo‘li
Wnt/β-katenin yo‘li
Notch signal yo‘li
mcq.explanation: NLRP3 inflammasoma ROS, hujayradan tashqari ATF yoki lizosoma beqarorligi bilan faollashadi. U IL-1β va IL-18 yetilishini kuchaytiradi, bu neytrofillarni jalb qiladi. Shu tariqa ROS–IL-1β kuchaytirish halqasi hosil bo‘lib, xurujlar qaytalanadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

mcq.question: Kichik bronxiola devorida silliq mushak giperplaziyasi va bazal membrana ostida I/III tip kollagen hamda laminin to‘planishi topildi. Bu qanday oqibatga olib keladi?
options: Devor yumshashi va o‘pka komplayensi ortishi
Shilliq kamayishi va yo‘llar kengayishi
Devor qotishi va qaytmas torayish kuchayishi
Kapillyarlar ko‘payishi va diffuziya yaxshilanishi
mcq.explanation: Miofibroblastlar ko‘p kollagen va laminin sintez qiladi, bu bazal membrana osti matriksining ortiqcha to‘planishiga olib keladi. Natijada yo‘l devori qotadi, o‘pka komplayensi pasayadi va torayish qaytmas bo‘lib kuchayadi. Silliq mushak giperplaziyasi ham stenozga hissa qo‘shadi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

mcq.question: Chekuvchi bemorda KT da distal mayda arteriyalar hajmi kamaygan, ammo COPD hali aniq emas. COPDGene ma’lumotlariga ko‘ra, bu nimani bashorat qiladi?
options: Bronxial astmaning tezkor bartaraf bo‘lishi
Emfizema tezroq avj olishi va FEV1 pasayishi
Qon eozinofillari kamayishi va ICS ta’siri
Alveolalar elastikligining o‘z-o‘zidan tiklanishi
mcq.explanation: COPDGene kohortasida distal mayda arteriyalar hajmining kamayishi (arterial pruning) emfizema progressiyasining tezlashishi va o‘pka funksiyasining pasayishi bilan bog‘liq. Boshlang‘ich parenximal buzilish hisobga olinganda ham bu bashorat saqlanadi. Demak, pruning kasallik rivojlanishining mustaqil omilidir.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

mcq.question: Kichik yoshdagi bola spirometriyadagi majburiy ekshalatsiyani bajara olmaydi. Kichik havo yo‘llaridagi ventilyatsiya notekisligini baholash uchun qaysi usul eng mos?
options: Bitta nafasli washout, majburiy ekshalatsiya bilan
Parametrik javob xaritalash, ikki marta CT bilan
Ko‘p nafasli washout, tinch nafas olish bilan
Perfluoropropan 19F MRT, nafasni ushlab turish bilan
mcq.explanation: Ko‘p nafasli washout (MBW) faqat tinch nafas olishni talab qiladi: nafas ushlash ham, majburiy ekshalatsiya ham kerak emas. Shu sababli u kichik bolalar va spirometriyani bajara olmaydigan bemorlar uchun qulay. Bitta nafasli washout esa bemorning maksimal hamkorligini talab qiladi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

mcq.question: Bemorda odatiy o‘pka funksiyasi ko‘rsatkichlari normaga yaqin, ammo nafas chastotasi oshganda dinamik compliance pasaymoqda. Bu eng ko‘p nimaga ishora qiladi?
options: Kichik havo yo‘llari disfunksiyasidan notekis ventilyatsiya
Sog‘lom o‘pkaga xos bir xil vaqt konstantasi mavjudligi
Faqat o‘pka to‘qimasi elastikligining izolyatsiyalangan oshishi
Faqat katta havo yo‘llaridagi turbulent oqimning kuchayishi
mcq.explanation: Sog‘lom o‘pkada vaqt konstantasi bir xil bo‘lgani uchun dinamik compliance nafas chastotasiga bog‘liq emas. Kichik havo yo‘llari obstruktsiyasida ventilyatsiya notekis bo‘ladi va tez nafasda ba’zi hududlar yetarli bo‘shalmaydi, shuning uchun compliance pasayadi. Bu kichik havo yo‘llari kasalligining erta ko‘rsatkichi.

source.author: Ruoyi Zhou va boshq.
source.title: Small airway disease as a key factor in COPD: new perspectives and insights, Frontiers in Medicine

mcq.question: Parametrik javob xaritalashda (PRM) fSAD (funksional kichik havo yo‘llari kasalligi) hajm foizi, ya’ni PRMfSAD, nimani ifodalaydi?
options: Emfizema tufayli hosil bo‘lgan past zichlikli hududlar hajmini
Bronxial devor qalinlashuvi va shilimshiq tiqinlar miqdorini
Arterial pruning tufayli tomir hajmining kamayish darajasini
Emfizemasiz kechadigan gaz tutilishi hududlarining hajm ulushini
mcq.explanation: PRM inspirator va ekspirator CT skanlarini ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazib, har bir voksel bo‘yicha emfizemani va emfizemasiz gaz tutilishini (fSAD) ajratadi. PRMfSAD aynan shu emfizemasiz gaz tutilishi hajmi ulushidir. Devor qalinlashuvi va shilimshiq tiqinlarni HRCT bilan baholash kerak.

mcq.question: Chekuvchi bemorda perfluoropropan 19F MRT o‘tkazilib, ventilyatsiya defekti foizi (VDP) hisoblandi. VDP asosan nimani aks ettiradi?
options: Butun o‘pkadagi umumiy havo oqimi cheklanishini
Lokal gaz tutilishi va o‘lik bo‘shliq mavjudligini
Faqat katta bronxlar devori qalinligining o‘zgarishini
Kapillyar zichligi kamayishining DLCO ga ta’sirini
mcq.explanation: FEV1 va FVC asosan umumiy havo oqimi cheklanishini ko‘rsatadi. VDP esa, ayniqsa kichik havo yo‘llarida, lokal gaz tutilishi va o‘lik bo‘shliqni aks ettiradi va shu sohada sezgirroq.

mcq.question: Senolitik dorilarning asosiy ta’sir mexanizmi qaysi javobda to‘g‘ri ko‘rsatilgan?
options: Qarigan hujayralarni tanlab apoptozga olib keladi
Barcha fibroblast turlarini bir xilda yo‘qotadi
Beta-2 retseptorlarini qo‘zg‘atib bronxlarni kengaytiradi
Alfa-1 antitripsin miqdorini tomir ichiga oshiradi
mcq.explanation: Senolitiklar qarigan hujayralardagi apoptozga qarshi yo‘llarni (masalan, BCL-2/BCL-XL, PI3K/AKT) vaqtincha to‘sib, ularni tanlab apoptozga yuboradi va sog‘lom hujayralarga tegmaydi. Ular bronxodilatator emas va alfa-1 antitripsin o‘rnini bosmaydi.

extras.text: Qiziqarli fakt: kichik nafas yo‘llari (ichki diametri 2 mm dan kichik, tog‘aysiz bronxiolalar) «jim zona» deb ataladi. Zararli zarrachalarga juda sezgir, lekin klinik jihatdan «ko‘rinmas» bo‘ladi. Ularning dastlabki funksional buzilishi simptomlar, spirometriya va rentgen o‘zgarishlaridan oldin boshlanishi mumkin. Shu sababli spirometriya normal bo‘lsa ham kichik yo‘llar kasalligini istisno qilib bo‘lmaydi.

extras.text: Eslab qolish usuli (emfizema zanjiri): tamaki tutuni → yallig‘lanish → proteazalar ko‘payadi → elastin buziladi → alveola devori yemiriladi → havo bo‘shliqlari kengayadi. Eng markaziy gipoteza — proteaza–antiproteaza nomutanosibligi. Oksidlovchi stress uni kuchaytiradi, chunki proteaza ingibitorlarini faolsizlantiradi. Doskada shu zanjirni strelkalar bilan chizing.

source.author: Bentaher A va boshq.
source.title: Pulmonary Emphysema: Current Understanding of Disease Pathogenesis and Therapeutic Approaches, Biomedicines

extras.text: Hodisa tahlili: elastin proteazalar ta’sirida bo‘laklanganda elastokinlar (elastin peptidlari) hosil bo‘ladi. Ular yallig‘lanish hujayralarini chorlaydi va yangi buzilish tsiklini ushlab turadi. Shu sababli elastokinlar kasallik belgisi va davolash nishoni sifatida o‘rganiladi. Desmozin (elastinning o‘ziga xos aminokislotasi) alveola devori buzilishining sezgir biomarkeri hisoblanadi.

extras.text: Eslab qolish usuli (kichik yo‘llar kasalligi 3 bosqichi): Boshlanish → Kengayish → Qayta qurilish. Boshlanishda epiteliy shikastlanadi, so‘ng EMT (epiteliy-mezenximal o‘tish), to‘siq buzilishi va shilimshiq tiqinlari paydo bo‘ladi. Kengayishda yallig‘lanish va hujayra qarishi (SASP) kuchayadi. Qayta qurilishda silliq mushak ko‘payadi, fibroz va tomirlar «qirqilishi» rivojlanadi.

extras.text: Diqqat: arterial remodeling ≠ kapillyar siyraklashuvi. Arterial remodeling mushakli arteriyalar devori qalinlashib, tomir qarshiligini oshiradi va o‘ng qorincha yuklamasiga olib keladi. Kapillyarlar siyraklashuvi esa kapillyarlar zichligini kamaytirib DLCO ni pasaytiradi va V/Q nomutanosibligini keltirib chiqaradi. Ikkalasi bir-birini kuchaytiradi, lekin fiziologik oqibatlari har xil.
